wine-shop: a small shop where wine and drink were sold
chateau: a large French country house or castle
tumbrils: open carts used to carry prisoners to execution

functionary: an official who carries out government duties

gallows: a wooden frame on which criminals were hanged

tidings: news or information about recent events
pavement: a paved footpath running alongside a road
drawbridge: a bridge that can be raised to block a gateway

garret: a small room at the top of a house under the roof

fete: a festival, feast, or public celebration
